## 👋 START HERE — setup in ~10 min

**1.** Connect **Google Gemini** credentials
→ node `Edit image`

**2.** Connect **Google Drive** credentials
→ nodes `Upload Drive` + `Download`

**3.** Press **Execute workflow** once
→ the Setup branch (bottom left) creates the
`staging_jobs` data table automatically

**4.** **Activate** the workflow, then open:
`https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/home-staging-form`

---

**Optional — 4K upscale:** create a *Header Auth*
credential on `Fal esrgan`: name `Authorization`,
value `Key YOUR_FAL_KEY` (fal.ai)

**Your branding & language:** edit the `BRAND`
block at the top of the `Page HTML` node
(`language: "en" | "fr" | "de"`)

**Your signature style:** edit `SIGNATURE STYLE`
in the `Brain` node

**Style catalog & thumbnails:** `STYLES` +
`STYLE_THUMBS` in `Page HTML` (see README)

**Access protection (optional):** `ACCESS_PIN`
& `DAILY_LIMIT` in the `Access gate` node

**Usage & costs dashboard:**
`https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/home-staging-stats`

### 🎨 Web app
Serves the form at `GET /webhook/home-staging-form`.
Rebrand it (logo, colors, tagline) in the **BRAND** block of `Page HTML`.

### 🧠 Generation pipeline
`Brain` turns the form into a detailed AI prompt (style library, room rules, brand-safety shield) → `Gemini` edits the photo → result saved to `Drive` → job marked done in the data table.

💡 Files go to *My Drive root* by default — pick a dedicated folder in `Upload Drive`.

### 🔍 Optional: 4K upscale (fal.ai ESRGAN)
Requires a fal.ai API key. Not using it? Delete these 3 nodes and remove the "Upscale (4K)" option from the HTML form.

### 🔐 Access & cost protection
The webhooks are PUBLIC once active. Defaults: `DAILY_LIMIT = 30` generations/day (cost cap), `ACCESS_PIN = ""` (open).

**For any public use, set an `ACCESS_PIN`** at the top of the **Access gate** node (the form asks for it once, then remembers it).

**To edit the daily limit from the Usage & costs dashboard** (no code), set the SAME code in THREE nodes: `Access gate`, `Stats page` AND `Save settings`. The dashboard then shows an editable limit; a value saved there overrides `DAILY_LIMIT`. Without the codes, the dashboard shows it read-only.

For production, put n8n behind Cloudflare/nginx with **per-IP rate-limiting** on `/webhook/home-staging-submit`. See the README security section.

### 🔄 Status, image & stats
The page polls `/home-staging-status?jobId=…` every 4 s, then loads the final image from `/home-staging-image?jobId=…`.

**Usage & costs dashboard:** open `/webhook/home-staging-stats` (optional `?pin=…`). Cost per image, language and PIN are set at the top of the **Stats page** node.

### ⚙️ Setup branch — run once
Creates the `staging_jobs` data table (reused if it already exists). Safe to re-run.
